$comment: Single source of truth for the PROJECT_ANALYSIS.md section 9.2 bundle budgets, restated as
CI gate thresholds per ADR-001 section 8. Enforced by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs.
1 KB = 1024 bytes, measured over gzip level 9 of the production build output (dist/),

initial-js.description: Initial JS (entry static import closure): FAIL > 100 KB gz, warn >= 80 KB gz

css.description: All CSS in dist/: FAIL > 20 KB gz

app-shell.description: Total app shell: FAIL > 200 KB gz (excl. icons/ manifest/ maps and lazy route+locale chunks; the service worker sw.js IS counted per ADR-001 section 8 / ADR-005 Decision 1)

locales.description: en+th locale packs: FAIL > 24 KB gz combined, FAIL if a locale pack is inside the initial JS closure (they must be lazy). 24 KB (was 20): ADR-007 §7.3 mandates the C1 copy catalog (59 keys × 2 locales) — the E10 budget predates the binding ADR; packs stay lazy (locales-lazy gate unchanged). RATIFIED at 24 KB by h_pm (PO delegate) 2026-10-26, decision card t_3faa5d95 — PROJECT_ANALYSIS §9.2 updated to match; deviation #11 of docs/dev/encryption-api.md §4 accepted.

no-external-refs.description: Runtime third-party bytes = 0: FAIL on any external http(s):// reference in shipped JS/CSS/HTML/SVG (XML namespaces are not network fetches; the CSP meta's plain-HTTP LOOPBACK source expressions for V1 WebDAV sync are not fetches either — ADR-006 Addendum A — and loopback is not third-party)

no-wasm.description: WASM = 0 in MVP: FAIL on any .wasm in dist/ (a WASM payload requires its own ADR first)
